title: The multitask prompt
goal:
Whisper chooses its task from the first decoder tokens (Section 2.3, Figure 1). The prompt is, in order: optional previous text after `<|startofprev|>`, then `<|startoftranscript|>`, a language token such as `<|en|>`, a task token (`<|transcribe|>` or `<|translate|>`), and `<|notimestamps|>` when timestamps are off.

Write two functions:

- `build_prompt(language, task, timestamps, prev_tokens=None)` returns the prompt as a list of strings. Raise `ValueError` for any task other than `transcribe` or `translate`.
- `prompt_loss_mask(tokens)` takes a full training sequence and returns a list of booleans, one per token. It is `False` for the previous-text tokens (strictly between `<|startofprev|>` and `<|startoftranscript|>`) and `True` everywhere else. The paper masks the loss over the previous context only (Section 2.3). This exercise keeps the two marker tokens themselves in the loss.
hints: Build the list in prompt order. The previous-text block comes first, and only when `prev_tokens` is non-empty.
`<|notimestamps|>` is added when `timestamps` is `False`, and it goes last, after the task token.
For the mask, find the index of `<|startofprev|>` and of `<|startoftranscript|>` with `tokens.index`. When the first marker is absent, nothing is masked.
